254:t_011:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Stop skulking in hiding and come out, damn it!」

254:t_012:0.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You're a warrior of $$ゲッター線$$...!」

254:t_012:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「No, you're one whose fate is toyed with by $$ゲッター線$$!」

254:t_012:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're still alive, you bastards! $$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$!」

254:t_012:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「W-what are they?! They're in space without suits!」

254:t_012:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「T-they're monsters! Those $$インベーダー#robot$$s may look worse, but those two... are real monsters!」

254:t_012:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「For once, I agree with $$ノノ$$.」

254:t_012:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「They're $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$... They were Earth scientists, but $$インベーダー#robot$$s are parasitizing them.」

254:t_012:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「And they led a huge army of $$インベーダー#robot$$s to seize Earth, where $$ゲッター線$$ gather.」

254:t_012:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They're an unknown energy raining down from space, said to have the power to make organisms evolve.」

254:t_012:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Professor $$早乙女#getter$$ studied $$ゲッター線$$ and developed the $$ゲッターロボ$$ to use them as its power source.」

254:t_012:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「We beat those old bastards to a pulp in the $$再世戦争$$, and they still haven't learned their lesson!」

254:t_012:12.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You still don't understand. That defeat means nothing to us.」

254:t_012:13.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We are chosen by $$ゲッター線$$. In other words, we are beings promised eternity.」

254:t_012:15.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「That's right, $$スティンガー$$.」

254:t_012:16.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「That's right, $$コーウェン$$.」

254:t_012:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm sick of your bullshit! If you've come back to life, I'll just knock you into an even deeper hell this time!」

254:t_012:18.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You still don't understand $$ゲッター線$$, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_012:19.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「And yet their power is what transported you here.」

254:t_012:21.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「I'll make it easier to understand.」

254:t_012:22.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「It's all your fault, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_012:24.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You must have noticed it yourself.」

254:t_013:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I don't know why... But my heart keeps burning hotter...!)

254:t_013:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I...! What the hell am I?!)

254:t_013:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「If you've come to die of your own accord, so much the better.」

254:t_013:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「I'll finish you off, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_014:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is this the time to be stubborn?!」

254:t_014:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We're in an unfamiliar place, facing a powerful enemy... in the vast universe...」

254:t_014:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's the best! Fighting spirit wells up from deep inside me!」

254:t_014:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「He's a warrior through and through.」

254:t_014:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's the man called $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_014:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Then I'll... snuff out your life for good!!」

254:t_015:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's been a while, $$正太郎$$... and you warriors of $c.」

254:t_015:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$! It really is you, $$グーラ$$!」

254:t_015:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Greetings can wait. First, I'll dispose of those pitiful gnats.」

254:t_015:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$グーラ$$ is fighting the $$インベーダー#robot$$s, too...!」

254:t_015:5.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You're the prince of the embodiment of the universe's darkness...!」

254:t_015:6.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「And you call us gnats...!」

254:t_015:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I'm no different from you. I'm like a gnat born in darkness, drawn to the light.」

254:t_015:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Earthlings will reach the sun's radiance.」

254:t_015:10.en:
$n
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire... And the sun's radiance...」

254:t_015:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Are you saying they were chosen by $$ゲッター線$$?!」

254:t_015:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Proof of that will arrive soon.」

254:t_016:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're here, $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

254:t_016:2.en:
$$凱$$
「We were suddenly thrown into a place like this! Show us a little consideration!」

254:t_016:3.en:
$$號$$
「Both of you, save it for later.」

254:t_016:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「I'm surprised. $c really was here, just as $$グーラ$$ said.」

254:t_016:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「You're fighting even here. You're as ill-fated as ever.」

254:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut up! You're just like me for going along with it!」

254:t_017:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Stop it... the $$ゲッターロボ$$!」

uncertain: 254:t_012:10: Saotome uses the Getter scientist identity, distinguished from the Macross surname homonym.
254:t_015:5: The source calls Gura the prince of the embodiment of cosmic darkness; the genitive relationship is preserved without inserting a new named sovereign.
254:t_015:10: Unresolved prophetic enumeration remains literal and unexplained after reading neighbors; assigning each element to a later revelation would add unsupported meaning.
